title: A Triumphant Exit
body:
# A Triumphant Exit

**UPDATED BASED ON COMMUNITY FEEDBACK:**

**We heard you. Respecting your time was always a core idea behind the Expedition Project system, so we've made further adjustments to how this round works.**

**The Expedition Window has been made longer. You can now meet the damage requirement any time between 28th April, 11:00 UTC and Monday 11th May, 07:00 UTC. This should give every player enough time to log in and secure those 5 bonus Skill Points. Below you'll find the full list of damage values needed for each Skill Point.**

Another Expedition Window is coming up, so it's time to prepare your caravan. For this third Expedition, we're changing the approach - most notably, Skill Points will now be earned through dealing damage across the five-day window, rather than through stash value.

Whether you've done this before or you're entering your first Expedition, here's a complete rundown of what's changing, what's required, and what you'll earn.

Once your caravan is finished, you'll have one final chance to make your mark before setting off.

## Timing:

The Expedition Window opens on 28th April at 13:00 CEST / 11:00 UTC / 04:00 PT. You'll have 13 days to sign up and finish the requirements. At 09:00 CEST / 07:00 UTC / 00:00 PT on 11th May, everyone who has signed up will depart automatically.

Finishing your caravan does not count as signing up for the Expedition - you still need to sign up separately within the window.

We're also adding a "last call" feature, explained further down.

**Expeditions are personal progression, completed in sequence. You can work on the Caravan at any point between Expedition Windows, but the Expedition itself can only be completed while its window is open.**

## How to do the Expedition:

* **Complete the Caravan.** You can begin contributing to the Caravan as soon as you finish your previous Expedition. If this is your first Expedition, you can start contributing immediately.

* **Wait for the Expedition Window.** The next window runs from 28th April 13:00 CEST / 11:00 UTC / 04:00 PT to 11th May 09:00 CEST / 07:00 UTC / 00:00 PT.

* **Sign Up.** Once the window opens, you must sign up.

* **Complete the Challenge.** To earn the extra Skill Points (5 total per Expedition), players must complete a challenge within the Expedition Window (details below).

* **Catch Up.** Players on their second or third Expedition can catch up on Skill Points missed earlier (maximum 5 per catch-up, details below).

* **Depart.** Everyone who has signed up departs on Monday at 09:00 CEST / 07:00 UTC / 00:00 PT.

## What's different?

Use your remaining gear to leave a lasting impression before you go.

* **A damage challenge replaces stash value as the way to earn Skill Points.**

* Rather than accumulating stash value and coins, players must now **deal damage** to earn all 5 Skill Points, whether this is their first, second, or third Expedition. Anyone who has completed their Caravan will receive the challenge automatically, with no need to sign up first to see it.

* The challenge can be completed by dealing damage with any weapon or gadget against any target, except in the practice range.

* Players have the full 13-day window (28th April to 11th May) to finish the damage challenge.

* **Damage requirements:**

* 1 SP: 5,000 damage

* 2 SP: 10,000 damage

* 3 SP: 30,000 damage

* 4 SP: 50,000 damage

* 5 SP: 100,000 damage

*For scale, 100,000 damage is roughly equal to destroying 20 Bastions. Internal testing showed that a single strong round could yield 8,000–10,000 damage.

* **Catch-up remains based on stash value.**

* Players departing on their second or third Expedition (not applicable to first-time players) who missed Skill Points from earlier Expeditions can catch up on them.

* The damage challenge must be completed first before the coin/stash value catch-up option unlocks.

* Catch-up costs 300,000 coins/stash value per Skill Point.

* **Trials**

* The final week of Season 3 ends on Tuesday, 28th April at 10:00 CEST / 08:00 UTC / 01:00 PDT.

* Unlike in previous seasons, Trials will remain available during the Expedition Window this time.

## Why have we made these changes?

We recognize that grinding purely for monetary value isn't the most engaging experience. Shifting to damage-based objectives and Trials instead of stash value gives more freedom and variety in how the Expedition can be completed, and encourages players to actually use their loot instead of hoarding it during the window. Our main goal is for Expeditions to feel fun rather than an endless grind. We believe these changes create a fair, engaging challenge that keeps everyone active throughout the window.

## What are the rewards?

Rewards are tied to personal progression, meaning that if this is your first Expedition, you'll only receive rewards from the first Expedition, and so on.

**Permanent**

Completing the Expedition grants permanent rewards that stay on your account forever.

* **Cosmetics:**

* The Patchwork outfit (evolved)

* New Toggles:

* Helmet

* Bandolier

* Leg Accessories

* Color Variations:

* White Red

* Black Green

* Scrappy Turban

* The Expedition Indicator icon (upgraded with each Expedition)

* **Bonuses:**

* +12 stash space per Expedition

* 12 stash space is awarded per Expedition. So if the maximum without doing any Expedition is 280, completing your first Expedition brings it to 292. Two Expeditions bring it to 304, three bring it to 316, and so on.

* +0-5 Skill Points (plus catch-up for missed Skill Points for those on their second or third Expedition, totaling 91 for those completing their third Expedition, with a maximum of 5 Skill Points per catch-up)

* Skill Points from the damage challenge grant the 5 base points, while catch-up Skill Points are earned through coins/stash value.

**Consecutive buffs:**

These buffs reset if you miss an Expedition Window. The numbers below reflect total percentages, not additions.

* 5% → 10% → 15% XP boost

* 6% → 12% → 18% Scrappy materials boost

* 60% → 70% → 80% Repair value increase

## New Feature 'Last Call':

Players who finish the Caravan but miss signing up during the Expedition Window will still get one more chance. On their next login, they'll see a pop-up offering a final opportunity to sign up. No damage requirement applies for this option, but no Skill Points will be granted either.

## Future expeditions:

Completing the third Expedition unlocks the full Patchwork outfit, while the fourth Expedition introduces the beginning of a brand-new outfit. Going forward, we'll keep collecting data and feedback to refine and improve future Expeditions. We've heard the feedback on rewards and are committed to making them feel more meaningful and better reflect what players actually accomplish. We also understand concerns about losing full progression, and we'll keep iterating on what resets and what carries forward into future Expeditions.

Good luck out there, Raiders.

The ARC Raiders Team
